scientific_question: Does one task-conditioned global log-volume coordinate per c_proj layer close the late full-MLP gap left by the trace-free hidden Givens chart, without adding a learned gain, basis, adapter, inference transform, or inference FLOP?

terminal_spectral_audit.fact: The determinant-one symmetric shear left the dominant mean-log-singular deficit unchanged while doubling centered spectral-shape error and inflating middle-layer temporal residuals.

retain: accepted c_fc directed-product schedule [22,22,22,22,22,22], radius 1, and decay-1 error feedback
c_proj hidden64 plus residual24 fresh Muon-matched Givens chart
learning rate, Muon settings, warmup, cosine schedule, data order, evaluation windows, seeds, and token budget
single_factor_change.add: After the hidden64+residual24 c_proj chart and before ordinary folded weight decay, fit exactly one signed log coordinate whose positive exponential uniformly scales the current materialized c_proj weight toward the remaining corrected Muon target.
single_factor_change.remove: No symmetric output-shear stages are present.
not_reopened: symmetric-shear stages, neighbors, condition bound, or learning rate
learned per-channel/global gain, learned basis, LoRA, HyperConnection, or persistent adapter
c_fc schedule, optimizer, or token horizon

stage_order: dense Muon requested c_proj update plus decay-0.5 temporal residual
ordinary folded materialized-weight decay and refreshed compression residual
operator.fit: Let X be the post-Givens materialized weight and T=X+R the remaining corrected target, where R is corrected_update-(X-W_old). Compute q=max(<T,X>/||X||_F^2, epsilon), a=clamp(log(q), -log(1.01), +log(1.01)), and X_new=exp(a)X.
operator.geometry: The coordinate adds a equally to every log singular value, changes rectangular pseudo-determinant log-volume by rank*a, and leaves the condition number exactly unchanged before common scalar weight decay.
operator.fold: The scale is applied directly to the materialized c_proj weight during the optimizer step; no scale parameter or transform remains in the forward graph.
operator.distinction_from_closed_gain_family: This is not an AdamW-trained persistent gain. It is a single ephemeral optimizer coordinate recomputed from the current corrected Muon target each update and folded immediately into the weight.

coordinate_accounting.accounting_scope: procedural optimizer-update coordinates only; materialized tensors remain present

required_tests: exact least-squares scalar recovery and deterministic signed clamp
uniform singular-value scaling, registered log-volume shift, and unchanged condition number
default-off behavior and invalid configuration rejection
bitwise exact two-step resume including the last log-volume coordinate, optimizer state, momentum, and temporal residual
exact scientific config parsing and c_fc/c_proj/attention structural binding

performance_gate.protocol: Foreground exact-scientific-config run with one warmup plus eight timed real training updates; direct polling and no watchdog because the gate must finish within five minutes.
performance_gate.fail_action: If MFU is below 20% or correctness/finite gates fail, do not launch. Optimize the exact registered implementation without changing the operator, cap, data, or schedule, then repeat the foreground gate.

scientific_run.curve_requirement: No fixed checkpoint may be worse than the rejected joint full-MLP control by more than 0.005 CE; report every exact difference regardless of pass/fail.
scientific_run.pass_action: If terminal CE is <=3.635838041305542, the full curve satisfies the requirement, and all finite/cap gates hold, accept global log-volume as the missing c_proj coordinate and quantify fixed-model token-compute plus execution overhead.
scientific_run.secondary_only_action: If primary fails but terminal CE is <=3.6478 and the curve gate passes, classify as partial trace recovery only; do not promote or tune without terminal volume/residual evidence.
scientific_run.fail_action: If terminal CE exceeds 3.6478 or the curve/stability gate fails, reject the scalar volume mode and do not sweep its cap, grouping, or learning rate.

monitoring.callback_action_prompt: verify terminal or error state and exact artifacts against the active project note; seal loss, log-volume/residual diagnostics, GPU health, provenance, and checkpoint hashes; update durable state; then continue the causal MLP plan autonomously
